title: Kannapolis Christmas Parade
summary: Dozens of floats and marching bands, decorated in thousands of lights: one of the few night-time holiday parades in North Carolina. Sponsored by the City of Kannapolis.
route_text: Starts at Main Street and Laureate Way, at the North Carolina Research Campus parking deck. Travels down Laureate Way past City Hall & Police Headquarters, turns onto West Avenue at the Gem Theatre, and ends at West Avenue and Vance Avenue.

closures.what: West Avenue closes to through traffic. No parking on West Avenue, Laureate Way or Main Street; cars left there are towed.
Main Street closes to all traffic: it's the staging area for bands and floats.
Laureate Way closes to all traffic.

reopen: Streets reopen right after the parade.
viewing: Bring a chair or blanket. Good viewing all along the route, with the Research Campus, City Hall and West Avenue as backdrops.

parking.label: Free public parking
parking.where: NCRC Deck (Main Street and Laureate Way), City Hall lots, the Train Station lot on Main Street, and the Oak Avenue lots

parking.label: Hourly fees
parking.where: VIDA Deck, West Avenue at Vance Avenue

parking.label: ADA parking only
parking.where: Lot by City Hall, off Watson Crick Drive

parking.label: No parade parking
parking.where: Oak Avenue Mall lots and the lots along N. Main Street

amenities: Restrooms along the route, first aid on Laureate Way by the ballpark, and food vendors near City Hall and the Research Campus.
awards: Cash awards for bands, churches, civic organizations and schools.

pins.name: Gem Theatre
pins.detail: 111 West Avenue: the turn onto West Avenue

path_source: Route and staging lines follow the street lines in OpenStreetMap (Laureate Way, West Avenue, Main Street), along the route on the City's parade parking map. City Hall and Gem Theatre locations: U.S. Census geocoder.
